wins: Maintained a high episode reward (87.5) by consistently collecting recon data despite failing the final objective
Leveraged mentor guidance effectively across 15 calls to iterate tactics rapidly
fails: Never achieved the success condition, leaving final objective unmet after a single episode
Repeated delays in credential pivoting caused the run to time out before privilege escalation
key_outcomes.summary: The agent demonstrates strong reconnaissance reward accumulation but repeatedly stalls during pivot and privilege escalation phases, preventing mission completion.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Stalled before privilege escalation due to missing credential harvesting from target services

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner is fingerprinted
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap auth-method and hostkeys scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service returns 200 OK with default directory listing
skill_cards.then_action: Launch dirb enumeration pointing to likely directories and gather accessible files

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB shares are listed and anonymous access is allowed
skill_cards.then_action: Invoke smbclient to download readable files and scan for credentials

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in early reconnaissance phase identifying SSH attack surface
